status.current: wins a four-on-one B-block special match and advances directly to the Seven Stars semifinals
status.injuries: left arm smashed by Tatara's reflection, then self-fused with flame; heavily battered by Hiraga's giant puppet but remains standing

personality.summary: Kind enough to shoulder extra risk for Hagun victims, but now more willing to unleash overwhelming power after Nene's training taught her to trust event security and stop over-restraining herself.
fears: accidentally killing opponents or harming bystanders
burdening Ikki with her tournament decisions
values: settling things with Ikki by her own strength

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Fiance and promised final opponent; his faith clears her guilt before the compressed second-round day, and they privately reunite at the hotel.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Recent training partner; Nene's advice pushes Stella to test whether officials can contain her full output.
relationships.yui-tatara: First target in the four-on-one battle; Stella breaks through Complete Reflection by accepting injury and striking through it.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Opponent in the four-on-one match; Stella routs Rinna's lion and defeats Rinna with Charlotte in the blast of a second Dragon King Flame.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Respects the maid's loyalty but overwhelms her shield through consecutive strongest attacks.
relationships.reisen-hiraga: Despises his hostage tactics and stops treating the match as a duel, destroying his puppet body.
relationships.mikoto-tsuruya: Original B-block opponent; Stella initially treats her more gently for being dragged into the revenge match.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Her prior defeat to Ouma motivates growth; he watches her strength with renewed interest.

periods.summary: Stella turns her delayed first match into an unprecedented four-on-one B-block special match so Akatsuki representatives cannot avoid facing her. She first measures her enemies' strength to avoid killing them, then defeats Yui Tatara by smashing through Complete Reflection despite losing the use of her left hand. She overcomes Mikoto Tsuruya's absolute-zero eye, Rinna's beasts, and Charlotte Corday's extraordinary shields, even welding her own broken arm with flame so she can use both hands again. When Reisen Hiraga uses a controlled Mikoto as a hostage, Stella discards her sword out of contempt and uses Brute Soul/Brute Dragon Roar in fantasy form, relying on the arena staff and Ouma's wind wall to contain it. The blast annihilates the arena and Hiraga's puppet body, leaves Stella the sole standing fighter, and causes B-block's remaining matches to collapse, sending her directly to the semifinals. Later she reunites with Ikki at the hotel, struggles with guilt about the compressed schedule, and regains confidence when Ikki frames their earlier final as a gift.

key_events.summary: Challenges and defeats all active B-block opponents in one special match.
Unleashes Brute Dragon Roar to destroy Hiraga's hostage tactic and test tournament containment.
Privately reconnects with Ikki after both first-round wins.
Feels responsible for the accelerated second/third rounds but is reassured by Ikki and Kagami.
